name: bank-support-duplicate-payment
description: One retail-banking support ticket (a duplicated debit card payment that caused an overdraft fee) and ten questions in a fixed order that cycles choice (4 options), score (4 levels), noul. A run with q questions sends the first q.

state.subject: Charged twice for the same payment
state.message: Hello, I paid my council tax of £142.50 by debit card on Monday and it has come out of my current account twice. The second payment pushed me into my overdraft and I've now been charged a £15 fee as well. I've banked with you for six years and this is the second time it has happened. Please return the duplicate payment and the fee this week, or I'll move my account elsewhere.

questions.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket?

criteria.payments: duplicate, failed or delayed card payments and direct debits
criteria.fraud: transactions the customer says they did not make

questions.instructions: Does the customer threaten to leave the bank?

criteria.email: a written reply to the same email thread
criteria.phone_call: a call back from an agent

questions.instructions: Is the customer asking for money to be returned?
Which product is the ticket about?

criteria.current_account: everyday banking, debit cards and overdrafts
criteria.credit_card: credit card balances, statements and repayments

questions.instructions: How much work will this take to resolve?
Does the ticket describe a payment the customer did not authorise?
What should the agent do first?

criteria.refund_duplicate: reverse the duplicate payment and the overdraft fee
criteria.open_dispute: raise a card dispute with the merchant
criteria.ask_details: ask the customer for more information
